description:
Event subtype — hierarchical classifier on every CloudEvent.

The dot-separated string form is what flows over the wire; the enum variants give us exhaustive matching at compile time and one single source of truth for the JSON Schema.

oneOf.description: Codex surfaces developer-role messages (instructions / system prompts shown as developer turns).
Codex emits a per-turn context frame (cwd, model, timezone) before the turn's events.
Codex emits running token accounting as a `token_count` event_msg.
Codex task lifecycle. `task_complete` is the signal we synthesize `system.turn.complete` from; `task_started` opens the turn loop.
Claude Code emits this with camelCase on the wire.
